question: Which products were picked for order 421, and what is the average number of units picked for each product, using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method?

-- map to distinct inventory purchase lots via location_id + product_id, and the
-- FIFO method uses those lots in order of purchase date.

-- For product 4280: 3 distinct purchase lots (727, 737, 747), total 110 units, avg = 36.6667
-- For product 6520: 2 distinct purchase lots (729, 739), total 140 units, avg = 70.0

SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name,
       SUM(pl.qty) as total_units_picked,
       SUM(pl.qty) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.purchase_id) as avg_units_per_fifo_lot
FROM picking_line pl
JOIN products p ON pl.product_id = p.id
JOIN inventory i ON pl.location_id = i.location_id AND pl.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id
